sources.title: VerilogCoder: Autonomous Verilog Coding Agents with Graph ... - NVIDIA
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose VerilogCoder, a system of multiple Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents for Verilog code generation, to autonomously write Verilog code and fix syntax and functional errors using collaborative Verilog tools (i.e., syntax checker, simulator, and waveform tracer).
